title: Sport Mode Driving Feel
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on sport mode and sporty driving feel, with positive comments about handling and engagement alongside several descriptive or issue-like mentions that do not state clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the G70 feels and handles more like a sports car, especially when driven in sport mode.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe sport mode behavior such as keeping the vehicle out of electric mode, disabling MSA, or changing center-display content without enough context to label the experience.

limitations: Most examples are very short fragments with limited context, so several mentions cannot be classified beyond undetermined.
The cluster includes both driving-feel praise and functional descriptions of mode behavior, which are related but not fully consistent as a single theme.
Samples are stratified and not representative of overall owner experience.
